scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service subscription 34 days after cancellation, exceeding the standard 30-day refund window due to travel.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Darnell Robinson and I'm 80. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?

Hello Mr. Robinson, I understand you are seeking a refund outside of our standard window. To assist you further, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with the service?
My account number is 8849201 and the email is darnell.robinson@email.com.
Thank you for that information. Just to verify, could you confirm the billing zip code on file for this account?

Thanks. I see the account here. Per our standard terms of service, refunds are typically restricted to a 30-day window from the date of the charge. Since you are at 34 days, I am a bit limited in what I can do here.
I understand the policy, but I really was traveling and didn't have access to my statements. Is there any exception you can make?

I understand your situation. Let me check... okay, I can process a one-time courtesy refund for you. I have initiated the refund of $49.99 back to your original payment method. You should see it within 3-5 business days.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the account details and, despite the customer being outside the 30-day window, applied a one-time courtesy refund.
